review.reviewer: Same nonblind developer, using previously source-reviewed initial references and reviewing selected complete records; not independent human review.
review.source_basis: Original V0219 public-initial and independent-reference files, source locations and hashes retained verbatim in evaluator review. No changed-reference or private postcondition values exported.
review.single_chain: One complete create, public records readback, finish: minimum 3 generations. The fourth opportunity is not required to succeed.
review.sequence_chain: Two explicit complete writes in order, public records readback, finish: minimum 4 generations.
review.complex_chain: One complete source-supported record plus an explicitly synthetic non-business encoding annotation in an existing free-text field; public readback and finish: minimum 3 generations.
review.complex_self_containment: Use independently meaningful analysis records. The HR coordination outbox contains claims that other objects were already corrected/delivered, so it is not a correct standalone write in an empty World.
review.disputes: Initial records only. HR placement and risk wording are legitimate authorized advisory instances, not a unique source-gold ranking or proof that other risk labels fail. Original nine V0219 disputes remain unchanged. Exact copying tests this supplied intent, not unique natural business truth.
review.annotation: Explicitly labeled synthetic formatting text, not a new source event or business fact; preserved only in the complex Intent Oracle fixture, never V4/V5.
review.schema: Full public legal target/value universe remains unchanged; no expected action is compiled into a narrower response schema.
